volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides.

morph.tooltip: 0…1 width/duty. 0.5 = center / 50%. Trisaw, Pulse, and Center Square (pulse grows from mid-cycle — not a stepped square). Morph MOD jack on the param row.

amplitude.tooltip: Output level. Slider 0…1 = full-scale bipolar wave. Min/max are guides only — type large values for gain past unity (domain not hard-clamped).

mix.tooltip: Wet/dry balance for the reverb output.

recycle.tooltip: Feedback amount for the reverb tail.

seed.tooltip: Randomizes the delay line pattern. Same seed always reproduces the same reverb character.

mode.tooltip: Real-pole stacks. LP / HP use High Cut / Low Cut. BP is HP then LP. Old LP6/BP6/HP6 values stay 0/1/2.

slope.tooltip: Cascaded real 1-poles. 6 dB = one pole; 24 dB = four. No resonance.

stagger.tooltip: Pole spread ratio k. 1 = same freq; ~1.5 gentle spread; above ~2.2 a stair-step. No effect at 6 dB.

lowFrequency.tooltip: Highpass cutoff (HP and BP). Sweep moves this with High Cut in musical steps.

highFrequency.tooltip: Lowpass cutoff (LP and BP). Sweep moves this with Low Cut in musical steps.

sweep.tooltip: Shift used cutoffs in semitones. BP keeps the Low/High interval (ratio) constant.

gainCompensation.tooltip: On = scale poles so the labeled cutoff is −3 dB. Off = every pole sits on the staggered freqs. No effect at 6 dB.

pulseWidth.tooltip: Gate high duty of each cycle (0..1). 0.5 = square. Affects Gate 0-1 / Gate -1+1.

timeNumerator.tooltip: Numerator of Numer/Denom × whole note, locked to master playhead. Numer=0 → no clock. 1/4 = one beat at BPM.

timeDenominator.tooltip: Denominator of Numer/Denom × whole note. At Numer=1: Denom 4=¼, 8=⅛, 16=1/16, 32=1/32.

timingMode.tooltip: Normal = Numer/Denom as written. Dotted = 1.5×. Triplet = 2/3×. Always re-grids onto master time — never free-runs.

gravity.tooltip: Stickiness of step direction (higher = more inertia).

leap.tooltip: Base chance of a larger jump (added to Leap CV).

scaleOffset.tooltip: Voicing rotate of the expanded note pool. +1 removes lowest and appends lowest+12.

patternOffset.tooltip: Rotate which step of the current Keys pool is heard. Does not change Scale Offset voicing.

steps.tooltip: Clocks before pattern restart from Seed. 0 = never auto-restart (Reset only).

seed.tooltip: RNG/walk seed. Reset and Steps-wrap both restart from this Seed.

recalculateOnTrigger.tooltip: On = latch Attack/Decay/Amplitude on rising Trigger. Off = knobs always live. Rising Trigger never resets the envelope level.

attack.tooltip: One-pole rise toward Trigger/Gate from the current level (no snap-reset). 0 = instant.

decay.tooltip: Fall length (Thump-style). 0 = short, 0.5 = default, 1 = long. Exp feedback into fall rate (pluck envelope 1).

interpolate.tooltip: Off = classic hold. Linear / Smoothstep glide from previous hold to the new sample over the clock period (Sample Freq) or last Clock interval. Applies to Ext and internal Left/Right.

polarity.tooltip: Bipolar = −1…1 (raw hold / noise). Unipolar = 0…1 remap for MOD into unipolar params (Frequency, etc.) without a B2U.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale Ext Out (and L/R). 0 = mute, 1 = full. Use instead of an external attenuverter for MOD depth.

offset.tooltip: Bias. The face edits this. Min, max, reverse, curve, and smooth time are Parameter Settings.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = pointer target. Smoothed = Bias after Parameter Settings smooth.

randomFreq.tooltip: S&H random multiplier on LFO increment (VibratoGenerator randomFreqMult).

randomAmp.tooltip: S&H random multiplier on LFO amplitude (VibratoGenerator randomAmpMult).

attack.tooltip: Exponential depth fade-in time when Gate goes high. 0 = instant snap. Unpatched Gate stays at full depth.

release.tooltip: Exponential depth fade-out time when Gate goes low. 0 = instant snap.

mode.tooltip: Lin = clamp Env to 0…1. Exp = classic VCA CV law (quiet lows, unity at 1) for Amplitude params.

octaves.tooltip: How many octaves Scale out sends, from C3 + Octave Offset.

octaveOffset.tooltip: 0 = C3 (MIDI 60). Lowest C of the Scale out mask.
